page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with marginal notes in the right margin. Running head at top, page number at top right.

p.i: Nunc ligat ad cæstum gaudentia brachia loris Miscile nunc disci pondus in or-be rotat.

main_text.p: Quod certaminis genus vel ideo forte à Lycurgo legisla-tore institutum, ut stirps eorum, qui gignerentur, validum in valentibus corporibus principium sumens, bene germinaret. Vel etiam, ut ita mares conspicati puellarum denudatarum formam, earum capientur amore, adeoque de inveundo matrimonio, quod cælibatum Græci vituperarent, consilium inirent. Vel denique, ut si qua necessitas cogeret, & fœminæ ad instar Amazonum, pro liberis, pro parentibus pro aris & focis, certare possent. Quidquid sit, nemovid. Plu-tarch. in Apopth. in Lycur-go. tamen sanæ mentis hoc insanum Lycurgi institutum probaverit. Puellas enim nudas, cum viris nudis, colluctari[?], cum-

page.notes: The marginal note in the right margin runs from beside "nemo" down to beside "nudas,", where its last word "go." stands; it is transcribed as one note at its starting place. "collu&ari" is printed with a ct ligature; transcribed as "colluctari" with [?]. Long s is printed as f in the original (e.g. "difci", "inftitutum", "fi", "fanæ"); transcribed as plain s. The "&" in "& fœminæ" and "& focis" is kept as printed. The running head is printed "De Duellis." with a full stop. Catchword "cum-" stands at the lower right below the last line.
